source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SSD Slot Number Check - NVMe
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe via NVMe adapter slot number is correctly

1. Insert all NVMe SSD into BP slot and check slot number

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define slot number

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Enumerate lsblk, /dev/nvme* and truncated nvme id-ctrl output.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Device, serial and claimed slot mapping.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; useful for controller/namespace identity but Linux names and id-ctrl do not establish physical bay numbering or prove full physical population.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds topology/serial map, operator insertion/slot evidence and read-only-only execution.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 baseline record exists; source/script reference and V2 were independently reviewed.

original_test_intent: Verify that every approved NVMe SSD physically populated behind the NVMe adapter/backplane corresponds to the platform-defined slot number, with an unambiguous mapping from physical bay through PCIe/controller/namespace to drive serial.
original_method: A qualified operator installs all in-scope SSDs and records physical bay labels/serials; the agent collects complete read-only PCIe, NVMe controller/namespace and enclosure information using the reviewed script/tooling; the owner reconciles the physical and electronic topology against the specification.
manual_activity: The source requires inserting all SSDs and checking physical slot numbers. Human installation and physical-label correlation are core acceptance; software inventory cannot establish the chassis bay label alone, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Chassis/backplane/adapter/PCIe topology and authoritative slot-number scheme
All expected SSD serial/model/firmware and intended physical bay assignments
Qualified operator, safe insertion/hot-swap procedure and per-bay photos
Reviewed internal script and validated nvme-cli/PCIe/enclosure fields that bridge electronic to physical topology
Expected device count, namespaces per controller and exception rules
safety_requirements: Use the approved service state for full SSD population; protect mounted/in-use storage and use ESD controls.
Do not infer physical slot from `/dev/nvmeX` enumeration order, which can change across boot or topology.
Limit commands to read-only queries for allowlisted controllers/namespaces and do not truncate fields required for mapping.
Stop on missing/duplicate/unexpected serial, wrong bay, connector issue or unstable topology; preserve evidence and do not auto-reseat.
agent_execution_scope: Validate expected topology/matrix and reviewed script/tooling; capture complete read-only PCIe/NVMe identity after operator population.
Build a candidate electronic topology mapping without asserting physical labels absent operator evidence.
Reconcile operator-attributed bay photos/checklist with electronic identifiers and report Tool Result without claiming physical work or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the authoritative slot scheme and full population matrix.
Physically insert/attest every SSD and record labels/serials at the chassis.
Resolve topology ambiguities and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only but incomplete: `/dev/nvme*` ordering is not a physical slot, namespaces are passed to `id-ctrl` as though controllers, and `head -30` may omit mapping fields. It cannot replace operator bay evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep manual physical mapping; supplement it with the reviewed project script and complete allowlisted PCIe/NVMe controller/namespace identity and any supported enclosure/slot metadata.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-SSD population, NVMe adapter slot-number check, referenced script and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a signed mapping table from chassis label to backplane port, adapter lane/controller, PCI BDF, NVMe controller, namespace and serial; validate every row with operator photos and complete read-only inventory.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, adapter/backplane firmware, SSD firmware, OS/kernel, nvme-cli and script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform slot-number/topology specification and reviewed internal slot-number script must define mapping.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the slot mapping traceable and avoids unstable Linux enumeration assumptions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every populated SSD/slot remains required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative topology and full physical population evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms expose no standard OS physical-slot attribute; operator/chassis evidence remains decisive.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a subset only if explicitly approved and reported; it cannot claim 'all SSD' coverage for unpopulated bays. Alternative mapping tools require validated equivalence to the physical slot scheme.
expected_evidence: Authoritative slot/topology specification and complete expected SSD/bay/serial matrix
Operator-attributed full-population and physical bay-label evidence
Complete PCIe/NVMe controller/namespace/serial inventory and reviewed script/tool versions
One-to-one reconciliation, missing/duplicate/unexpected findings, relevant logs, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently defer correct slot numbering to the platform specification. Missing mapping data is readiness, not contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical-to-logical mapping objective is clear. Missing topology or operator is readiness; physical population and label proof make the case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains read-only inventory but rejects YES and Linux-name-to-slot inference.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology/operator requirements while applying the strict MANUAL ONLY rule for physical insertion and label correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines the complete physical-to-PCIe-to-NVMe chain and prevents truncated/inappropriate id-ctrl use.

review_improvement: Prevents unstable OS device numbering from being reported as chassis slot validation and makes every slot/serial traceable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because the test's truth condition is a physical slot label and the source requires full physical insertion, software evidence alone is insufficient. Human installation/correlation is core, so MANUAL ONLY is correct.

no_automatic_retry: Preserve any topology mismatch. Do not reseat, reorder enumeration or reboot to force a mapping automatically; await owner-directed inspection.
